prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1312; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and reported acute lumbar pain radiating mildly into the right buttock without numbness, tingling, or weakness in the lower extremities. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and restricted range of motion in flexion and rotation, with a negative straight leg raise bilaterally. Neurological screening was within normal limits. Imaging was not indicated given the absence of red flag symptoms. The diagnosis is acute lumbar strain.

Over the course of eight visits, treatment consisted of manual therapy, targeted stretching, graded core strengthening, and a home exercise program, along with short-term use of muscle relaxants and anti-inflammatory medication as needed. Pain decreased steadily from an initial rating in the moderate range to minimal discomfort by the final visit. Range of motion returned to near baseline, and the patient demonstrated improved tolerance for prolonged sitting and lifting.

At discharge, the patient was ambulating independently without restriction and was cleared to return to full daily activities and work duties. Continued independent home exercise was recommended, with follow-up as needed should symptoms recur.
